advisories.reason: Only used by tools on the development machine (@expo/cli and eslint-plugin-react-hooks) to validate our own configuration files; it does not reach the app bundle. The fix only exists in zod 4 and @expo/cli requires zod 3, in the canary version too.

Only used by @expo/config and jest-config on the development machine to merge our own configuration; it does not reach the app bundle. There is no fixed version: the package has been unmaintained since 2023.

Only used by tools on the development machine (@expo/fingerprint and Jest coverage) with patterns from this project; it does not reach the app bundle. The fix only exists in minimatch 11 and there is no patch for versions 9 and 10, the ones Expo and Jest require.

Only used by tools on the development machine (@expo/cli, @expo/fingerprint and Jest) on folders of this project; it does not reach the app bundle. The fix only exists in glob 14; Expo requires version 13 and Jest version 10.
